Ubbi Dubbi Translator

Encode English into Ubbi Dubbi (inserting 'ub' before every vowel sound) and decode it back.

Your translation will appear here.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste your text.
  2. Choose Encode or Decode mode.
  3. Press Translate.
  4. Copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does Ubbi Dubbi encoding work?

'Hello' becomes 'hubellubo' — 'ub' is inserted before every vowel (a, e, i, o, u).

Can I decode Ubbi Dubbi back to English?

Yes. Decoding removes each 'ub' that sits directly before a vowel, restoring the original text.

What about words that already contain 'ub'?

Words that already contain 'ub' before a consonant (like 'subway') are left alone by the decoder.
